creationInfo.comment: Placeholder SPDX document. GitHub's dependency-graph SBOM endpoint (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependency-graph/sbom) returned a 4xx response — see https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/issues/50. The Syft-generated SBOM at docs/SBOM/syft-scan.spdx.json remains the canonical dependency inventory until the upstream action (qte77/gha-sbom-action#16) ships the gh-api exit-code validation fix and Dependency Graph is confirmed enabled in Settings → Code security.
